hero.title: Learn languages through immersion

about.title: We believe you learn a language by using it
about.lead: HofShiLang grew from a simple idea: you learn a language by living it, not by memorizing loose rules.
about.body: That's why we bring immersive reading, native audio, AI conversation and spaced repetition into a single experience. Every word shows up in context, sounds in its right voice, and comes back at the exact moment to make it stick. Less mechanical memorizing, more real contact with the language — the way the brain actually learns.

values.title: Context
values.desc: Words only make sense — and stay — when they come from real texts and conversations.

values.title: Consistency
values.desc: A little every day beats a lot once in a while. The right review takes care of that.

values.title: Confidence
values.desc: Speaking early, without fear of mistakes, is what unlocks fluency.
